subject: HelmTech renewal: term adjustment + capacity add
messages:
From: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@helmtech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelmTech renewal: proposed term shift + capacity increase

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks for the conversation last week. HelmTech is aiming to shift the renewal to a 24-month term starting 2029-07-01 and increase committed capacity by 40% across embeddings and hosted inference. I've attached our internal request and a rough schedule.

High level asks:
- 24-month MSA term (start 2029-07-01)
- Addendum for 40% capacity uplift with staged billing (Q3/Q4)
- Clarify data retention and audit log retention for 24 months

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support the term change and provide a redlined MSA by EOD Thursday? We have a procurement window the week of 6/10.

Attachments: HelmTech_Renewal_Request_20290603.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Samantha Blake
Head of Procurement, HelmTech
samantha.blake@helmtech.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@helmtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2029 11:45:23 -0700
Subject: Re: HelmTech renewal: proposed term shift + capacity increase

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear summary.

Quick confirmation:
- Redwood can support a 24-month MSA term starting 2029-07-01.
- We can scope a phased capacity uplift; billing cadence and staged commit tiers will need to be reflected in the order form/addendum.

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Karthik will produce a redline of the MSA that addresses term, retention, and the standard SLA credit language for longer commitments.
2) Marissa will draft an order-form addendum that shows the staged capacity and pro-rated billing schedule.
3) I'll coordinate internal approvals and aim to return redlines by Thu 6/6 EOD to meet procurement window.

I'm attaching the first-pass redline for internal review (redlined_msa_draft_v1.docx). Karthik — please review the retention and liability carveouts and flag anything that needs legal escalation.

On the retention ask, we normally offer 12 months standard; 24-month retention is doable but I want legal to confirm any export/control impacts.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Account Director, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Attachment: redlined_msa_draft_v1.docx (docx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Jun 2029 09:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: HelmTech renewal: proposed term shift + capacity increase

Vivek — reviewed the draft redline. Key points:

1) Term & renewal: Clean — 24 months effective 2029-07-01. I added a renewal notice clause (Section 2.3) to allow earlier notice if HelmTech wants to convert to dedicated capacity.
2) Retention: Changed "12 months" to "24 months" in Section 5.1 and added the standard customer-requested export controls clause (new subparagraph 5.1.3). Legal caution: 24 months increases e-discovery surface; added language to limit scope to account-level logs vs. raw token streams.
3) SLA credits: For extended terms we provide enhanced SLOs; included a schedule that ties credits to sustained latency breaches only (avoid per-token metrics).
4) Liability cap: I tightened the cap to preserve limits for long-term commits; flagged for leadership signoff (Lauren).

I've attached a tracked-changes file: msa_redlines_trackchanges.docx (docx). Marissa — your order-form worksheet looks good but please add the staged billing rows and an explicit start date per tranche.

If no major objections, propose we send this to HelmTech with a short cover note and a DocuSign link target for one-week signature window.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: msa_redlines_trackchanges.docx (docx)
From: Samantha Blake <samantha.blake@helmtech.com>

Vivek / Karthik — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear redlines. We've reviewed Karthik's changes and the retention language is acceptable pending a minor tweak on the wording that limits log access to "aggregated account metrics" — I'll let contracts@helmtech.com make that exact edit.

We're good to proceed with execution. Please send a DocuSign packet with the MSA + order-form addendum; target signature window by 6/14 so we can align billing for July.
